text: It's no longer a requirement to provide any document proving that you have registered as married - it is enough that you can provide a certificate saying that you are single, along with the marriage certificate. This is a relatively new requirement, from early 2004. Some clerks might not know about it, so you may need to 'educate' them if they ask for it. You can read about it here :) https://aic.org.il/2024-big-updates-to-partner-visa-procedures-5-2-0008-5-2-0009/#:~:text=1%2E%20Marriage%20Registration%20in%20Country%20of%20Origin%20No%20Longer%20A%20Threshold%20Condition
